graph_audit.issue: SKU-level entities and historical relationships are not loaded
graph_audit.why_it_matters: Cannot yet link SKU to supplier, brand, category, season, BOM, lifecycle, channel sales or substitutions reliably.
graph_audit.needed_source: curated PostgreSQL/Vario schema and article master

graph_audit.why_it_matters: Unknown whether quantities are ordered, paid, shipped, net of refunds/cancellations, promo-adjusted or censored by unavailable stock.
graph_audit.needed_source: sales fact definition, order lines, availability history

graph_audit.issue: Inventory and incoming purchase orders are not represented in this graph
graph_audit.why_it_matters: A stock recommendation needs sellable on-hand, blocked/reserved stock and dated incoming supply, not only the latest observed stock.

graph_audit.issue: Set/BOM and bundle relationships are category-level, not SKU/version-level
graph_audit.why_it_matters: Public descriptions cannot establish exact components, quantities or historical composition changes.
graph_audit.needed_source: versioned ERP BOM and order-line data

graph_audit.why_it_matters: Own/foreign products, substitutions, bundles and channel shifts are not proven causal relationships; co-movement alone can mislead.
graph_audit.needed_source: confirmed product mapping, basket data, promotions and experiments

graph_audit.issue: Economic objective is directional but unquantified
graph_audit.why_it_matters: Lost sales, cross-sales, ranking damage, capital, storage and write-off costs cannot yet be compared on a common scale.
graph_audit.needed_source: SKU/channel contribution margin, ranking proxy, holding/write-off costs

graph_audit.issue: Ads entity lacks campaign-level data and attribution
graph_audit.why_it_matters: A sales database built for ads does not prove the availability of cost, impression, click, conversion or causal lift metrics.

graph_audit.issue: Public catalog is not the canonical catalog
graph_audit.why_it_matters: Storefront counts are dynamic and may include third-party products/overlapping collections; they are not SKU master data or assortment eligibility.
graph_audit.needed_source: Vario item master and assortment-status history

graph_audit.why_it_matters: The original chat mentioned roughly eight years, while the current curated PostgreSQL source is confirmed for two years plus current year and Vario starts 2026-09-01.

open_validation: Daniel will inspect the curated PostgreSQL basis later; then confirm read-only access method, schema, refresh watermark and source-of-truth fields.
Reconcile the May-chat statement of roughly eight historical sales years with Daniel's current confirmed PostgreSQL coverage (last two years plus current year) and uncertain Vario migration.
Determine whether the PostgreSQL source contains ad spend, campaign dates, impressions, clicks, conversions, gross margin/cost and seasonality labels, or only sales.
Get read-only access and schema/sample of the curated PostgreSQL data before building a separate Vario connector.
Verify supplier lead-time, purchase interval, supplier ID, cost and order-minimum fields are all available in the data source.
Confirm current presence of OBI/Hornbach/Bauhaus and SKU/channel granularity against actual database tables.
Website counts and copy are public snapshots, not authoritative assortment, BOM, sales, margin or procurement records.
Clarify cannibalization/relationship links between own brand, foreign brands, seed sets, bundles and seasonal campaign items using sales data and campaign metadata.
Map actual Vario supplier IDs separately from public-facing brand names; a brand label is not necessarily the purchasing vendor.
Map product lifecycle states, assortment-active dates, seasonality flags and analog/reference-SKU links at SKU level.

Quantify or choose defensible proxies for lost direct sales, lost combination sales, possible ranking damage, and overstock costs so the stockout-vs-overstock objective can be operationalized. Scheduled for workshop: ../plan/workshop-kostenmodell.md.
Define operational criteria for top seller/new/niche segmentation and exact forecast rules per segment.
Define success metrics and guardrails for the first order-planning phase before expanding to assortment and seasonal ads.
Define the external-system stock field semantics (physical vs saleable/reserved/on-order stock).
Confirm set BOM versioning/source and ensure allocating set demand to components will not double count component sales.
Confirm how zero sales are distinguished from no stock/listing inactivity and how returns/cancellations/promotions affect the sales measure.
